question: Should experimental Claws adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical exported package format while continuing to accept grouped JSON input?
rationale: This creates a user-authored manifest format and changes the export artifact, so tests alone cannot decide the intended durable package contract or stacking plan.

options.title: Confirm the canonical format
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export contract, subject to direct round-trip proof and normal review of the parent lifecycle stack.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain grouped JSON as export output and treat `CLAW.md` only as a future authoring proposal until the lifecycle direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Confirm the canonical format
recommendation.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export contract, subject to direct round-trip proof and normal review of the parent lifecycle stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest visible feature-history connection, including the earlier CLAW.md implementation and the active stacked replacement.
